chart: C3 To Hit Table: the Vehicle row and the C4 APDS/APCR row
boundary: The Vehicle row's black and red Basic TH# at each range, and the C4 APDS/APCR modification row. The Infantry row and the other C4 rows are in c3-to-hit-table.transcription.json; the Area row and the SMOKE row are outside both.
reading: Each range column prints two Basic TH#: black first, red second (C3.3; confirmed on a rendering). The red dot after "Vehicle" refers to the chart's note that ATR and MG counters use the black TH# unless captured. The APDS/APCR values modify the Basic TH# (C4.5).
